warp.bot: Use for delayed welcome/drip journeys. Prefer prop onboarding-stage=done. Actions: wait | warp | branch | halt. Contact messages: warpId joai-contact-message-send with Hook-style inputs. Campaigns remain for newsletters/backfill. Requires Automations native app.

inputs.name: Trigger type
inputs.bot: prop (contact property), segment, manual (run_automation only), or webhook (inbound Hook enroll).

inputs.name: Trigger config
inputs.bot: For prop: {"propKey":"onboarding-stage","propValue":"done"}. For segment: {"segmentId":"…"}. For webhook: {"source":"stripe"} (inbound Hook source query param).

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON. Types: wait {delayMinutes}, warp {warpId, inputs}, branch {when[], thenPosition, elsePosition}, halt {}. Example contact message: {"type":"warp","config":{"warpId":"joai-contact-message-send","inputs":{"contactId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.id"},"message":{"source":"literal","value":"Hallo {{name}}"},"subject":{"source":"literal","value":"Hi"},"integration":{"source":"literal","value":"email"},"recipientId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.email"}}}}. Wait uses delayMinutes only (0 = immediate). Multiple warps allowed.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Agent UUID. Required for webhook triggers and when warps need a sending agent (e.g. joai-contact-message-send). The agent must have the channel configured. There is no team-wide fallback.

en: Add a new product with a price to your shop catalog

en.question: What do I need to create a product?
en.answer: A name and a price in cents. Unit, tags, description, and details are optional.

en.question: Can I add volume pricing?
en.answer: Yes. Add variations with different SKUs and prices for bulk or volume tiers.

en.question: How do I add nutrition or specs?
en.answer: Pass meta.details as sections with kind kv (label/value rows) or text (a block).

de.question: Was brauche ich, um ein Produkt zu erstellen?
de.answer: Einen Namen und einen Preis in Cent. Einheit, Tags, Beschreibung und Details sind optional.

de.question: Kann ich Mengenrabatte anlegen?
de.answer: Ja. Füge Varianten mit unterschiedlichen SKUs und Preisen für Mengenstufen hinzu.

de.question: Wie füge ich Nährwerte oder Specs hinzu?
de.answer: Übergib meta.details als Abschnitte mit kind kv (Label/Wert-Zeilen) oder text (Textblock).
